digest.component_or_area: backend port abstraction / vendor reach-through elimination
propositions: Backend-neutral core modules contain hardcoded lazy-load keys for Jira adapter modules (adf, comment_limits), causing vendor code execution unconditionally for any configured backend.
ADF decoding and comment-truncation are scattered across literal module loads rather than consolidated behind backend port interfaces (FieldSanitizer and InboundMapper).
Outbound comment path calls adf_to_text to decode remote Jira ADF dicts for diff comparison, and calls truncate_comment_body to fit-to-limit, both via vendor lazy keys instead of port delegation.
Inbound apply path loads Jira adf module by literal key to normalize raw ADF bodies to text as defense-in-depth (bug 1bb2-5da5), leaking vendor coupling into neutral core.
After porting both code paths to FieldSanitizer.fit_comment and InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text, all vendor lazy-key literals must be deleted from core modules and verified absent by a sweep gate.
